<div class="card-body">
'''Red 6''' is a [[Light]] [[Starship]] ([[Starfighter]]) from [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">レッド6</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">パイロットを1名追加できる。レッド6に対して「トラブルが発生した」を使用する場合、相手は運命数に2を加えられる。パイロットなしでは戦闘力、回避力、航行速度を使用できない。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-ANH-Red-6-PSA-90960110.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ヤヴィンの戦いでジェック・ポーキンズが搭乗したＸウイング。デス・スター攻撃に使用された。コンピュータと飛行システムの最終点検を受けていない。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Red 6.

'''Card text:'''
May add 1 pilot. When A Problem Occurred is used against Red 6, the opponent may add 2 to destiny. Without a pilot, power, maneuver, and hyperspeed cannot be used.

'''Lore:'''
X-wing that Jek Porkins flew at the Battle of Yavin. It was used in the Death Star attack. It did not receive the final inspection of its computer and flight systems.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese lore says the X-wing was used in the Death Star attack, not that it was instrumental in strafing success.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Red 6]] in [[A New Hope (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 42, 101. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
